channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Martin County brush fires contained, Florida Forest Service expects more this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike. Both are now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks prompt Treasure Coast residents to adjust diets
item.description: Health officials confirm five local cases of cyclospora since May, including two in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County, as contaminated produce linked to national outbreaks raises concerns.

item.title: Severe weather brings waterspouts, lightning strikes and fires to Treasure Coast
item.description: Friday's severe weather left a trail of impacts across the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County, including waterspouts in Sebastian and lightning-related fires in Port St. Lucie.

item.title: Wellington teen injured after electric bike rider strikes him during stunt near Lion Country Safari
item.description: A Wellington teenager suffered multiple injuries, including broken bones, after being struck by an electric bike rider performing a wheelie on Tuesday night.

item.title: Rep. Angie Nixon gets September trial date for Capitol sit-in charges
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon learned she will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office.

item.title: Boynton Beach firefighters rescue dog from raw sewage lift station
item.description: A dog fell roughly 10 to 12 feet into a lift station holding about 2 feet of raw sewage Thursday, prompting a specialized confined space rescue.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route in September, cites low demand
item.description: JetBlue is ending its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9.

item.title: Waterspout crosses Indian River Lagoon as severe storms batter Treasure Coast
item.description: Severe weather swept across the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County on Friday, leaving behind waterspouts, lightning strikes and fires. item.title: Man airlifted to hospital after lightning strike in Okeechobee County
item.description: Fire rescue crews transported a man to the hospital by air after he was struck by lightning during Friday's severe weather.

item.title: Lightning ignites brush fire on Castinet Lane in Port St. Lucie
item.description: Lucie County Fire District crews contained a vegetation fire after a lightning strike ignited a lot near the 1900 block of Castinet Lane.

item.title: House fire reported on Bellevue Avenue during Port St. Lucie storms
item.description: Fire crews responded to a house fire at the 900 block of Bellevue Avenue during Friday's severe weather, with the fire marshal's office still investigating the cause.

item.title: Port St. Lucie resident records over 3 inches of rain in Friday storms
item.description: Merry Moore O'Rourke reported her rain gauge caught over 3 inches as severe weather moved through Port St. Lucie.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to New York JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Treasure Coast residents avoid lettuce and produce amid E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks
item.description: Health officials said thousands across the U.S. have been affected by E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks linked to contaminated lettuce, with confirmed cases also reported locally from the Palm Beaches into the Treasure Coast.

item.title: Florida Panthers to open 2026-27 season on road, face Stanley Cup Champion Hurricanes
item.description: The Panthers will begin their NHL season on Sept. 29 against the 2026 Stanley Cup Champion Carolina Hurricanes before returning home to Amerant Bank Arena in October.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks 27-year-old mile world record at London Diamond League
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 Saturday in London, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's 1999 world record of 3:43.13.

item.title: World Cup final security ramped up for Sunday's Argentina-Spain match in New Jersey
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies have implemented a security plan two years in the making as the 2026 FIFA World Cup concludes Sunday.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday night to prevent teams from using AI for substitutions, pitch calling, and other in-game decisions.

item.title: Flip City gymnasts from Treasure Coast earn top 15 national finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month, qualifying them for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Vero Beach truck accident lawyer explains importance of documenting collision evidence
item.description: A top truck accident lawyer in Vero Beach says documenting evidence at the scene remains one of the most overlooked steps after a collision.
